items.pregunta: Does every new or changed route require authentication, considering the middleware of the mount point?
items.evidencia: Mount point plus the order of the route's middlewares

items.pregunta: Does the authenticated identity scope the data (no crossing between tenants; if it is not theirs, 404)?
items.evidencia: A `where` on the tenant id derived from the credential, not from the body

items.pregunta: In public operations that create rows or call third parties, is there a captcha or rate limit, and is it bound to the action?
items.evidencia: Middleware and validation of the action or the threshold

items.pregunta: If configuration is missing (env, secret), does the control fail closed instead of letting the request through?
items.evidencia: The branch that runs when the configuration is absent

items.pregunta: Is there another route that does the same without the new control? Who can call it?
items.evidencia: Sibling routes and the origin of the credential they require

items.pregunta: Is the body validated at the boundary before it is used?
items.evidencia: Validation or parser of the body

items.pregunta: Do error responses avoid revealing internals (stack, SQL, other users' ids)?
